relations.relationship: Questions a simple replacement model of cultural approaches while investigating historical meanings and cultural variation.
relations.evidence_note: Reuse of the existing essay reading, PDF pp. 1–13 and selected opening of p. 14. The arrow adopts its limited anti-succession argument, not all of Burke’s survey or a verified genealogy for every predecessor.

relations.relationship: Explains how changes in research scale alter plausible explanations, linking regional cultural variation with wider comparisons.
relations.evidence_note: Primary interview, question 7, read. Burke discusses the scale question and describes his own popular-culture research; this is a methodological contribution, not membership in one microhistorical school or a claim that he invented scale analysis.
